full_llm_interaction_log.purpose: Implementing the u-shapelet algorithm with proper paper annotations
full_llm_interaction_log.prompt: Implement the full u-shapelet algorithm from the paper: sdist function, gap metric, greedy iterative discovery, distance map construction, and final k-Means clustering. Annotate each function with the corresponding equation/section from the paper.
full_llm_interaction_log.how_it_helped: The LLM provided the implementation of sdist, compute_gap, find_best_ushapelet, discover_ushapelets, and build_distance_map functions with annotations referencing specific paper equations and sections.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_modification: I modified the implementation to use randomised candidate search (200 candidates per iteration) instead of exhaustive search for computational tractability. I also added the early-abandon optimization hint in the sdist function and adjusted the MIN_GROUP_SIZE parameter.
full_llm_interaction_log.student_verification: I verified the sdist function by checking that sdist of a subsequence against its source time series returns approximately 0. I verified the gap metric produces expected results on a hand-crafted bimodal distance vector.
